facts: One upper semicircle with its entire half-disk shaded by diagonal down-right hatching.
A common horizontal x axis and vertical y axis meet at labelled O, the midpoint of the diameter.
B is the left diameter endpoint, with a negative-R and zero coordinate tuple below it. A is the right endpoint, with a positive-R and zero tuple below it.
Both endpoints are on the x axis; the top of the semicircle meets the y axis.
The x line extends beyond both endpoints and is labelled x at the right. The y line extends through O, above the semicircle and a short distance below the diameter.
Short positive-direction arrows are visible on the horizontal and vertical axes near O. Adjacent basis-vector glyphs have i-family and j-family roles.
No grid, independent subfigure, numeric radius, dimension arrow, sphere, cultural object or additional curve is present.
